e.title: Lakeside Mutual
e.summary: 保险领域微服务示例（Microservice API Patterns，192★）：DDD/API 模式的行业样例
e.body:
Lakeside Mutual（Microservice-API-Patterns，GitHub 192★+）是《Microservice API Patterns》一书的配套示例：以虚构保险公司 Lakeside Mutual 演示微服务 API 模式（DDD、PoEAA、EIP 等）。对 RIAA：保险 IT 微服务架构的教学样例——保单/客户/理赔服务的领域建模与 API 设计；与 [[digital-claims-management]]（企业理赔系统）、[[ai-insurance-multiagent-mcp]]（多智能体微服务）对照「传统微服务 vs AI 微服务」；保险系统架构课程/毕业设计的参考书。

## 同类工具
[[lemur]]、[[lifeflow]]、[[loss-reserving-chainladder]]、[[actsim]]、[[actuarcredibility]]

e.summary_hk: 保險領域微服務示例（Microservice API Patterns，192★）：DDD/API 模式的行業樣例
e.body_en:
Lakeside Mutual (Microservice-API-Patterns, 192+ GitHub stars) is the companion example of the book Microservice API Patterns: a fictional insurer (Lakeside Mutual) demonstrating microservice API patterns (DDD, PoEAA, EIP and more). For RIAA: a teaching example of insurance-IT microservice architecture — domain modelling and API design for policy/customer/claims services; contrast traditional microservices vs AI microservices with [[digital-claims-management]] (enterprise claims system) and [[ai-insurance-multiagent-mcp]] (multi-agent microservices); a reference for insurance-systems architecture courses and final-year projects.

## Similar tools
[[lemur]]、[[lifeflow]]、[[loss-reserving-chainladder]]、[[actsim]]、[[actuarcredibility]]
